purpose: Teach: 一体化/つとめ/マネージメント/結集/少人数/樹立/取り込ん/交互

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、各課を一体化した捜査本部を立ち上げられますね
lines.en: The police are setting up an integrated investigation headquarters across all departments, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, observational tone. Speaks with careful precision, as though confirming details. Steady pace, no rush. Respectful acknowledgment without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民への防犯おつとめも担当されますね
lines.en: The police are also taking on crime prevention duties toward the community, aren't they?
lines.style: Same measured cadence. Slight upward lilt on the question tag—genuine inquiry underneath the statement. Clear-eyed, noting the scope of responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署のマネージメント体制も改善されますね
lines.en: The police are improving the management structure at the station level too, aren't they?
lines.style: Continues with steady, methodical delivery. Each point lands with quiet intentionality. No hurry, no skepticism—just careful documentation of facts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、特捜班に精鋭を結集されますね
lines.en: The police are concentrating their elite personnel into the special investigation unit, aren't they?
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 'elite'—acknowledging the caliber of effort. Still measured. The tone carries respect for the commitment without overstatement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、少人数の捜査チームで動かれますね
lines.en: The police are operating with smaller investigation teams, aren't they?
lines.style: Brief pause before this one—noting the strategic shift. Delivered with understanding of the efficiency this suggests. Still calm, still careful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新拠点の樹立を進められますね
lines.en: The police are moving forward with establishing new operational bases, aren't they?
lines.style: Slight forward momentum in the delivery—the word 'forward' carries intention. Steady tone, but energy picks up fractionally on 'establishing.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の通報を取り込んで捜査されますね
lines.en: The police are incorporating citizen reports into their investigations, aren't they?
lines.style: Warmth enters slightly here—acknowledgment of community involvement. Still precise, but the tone softens marginally. Collaborative note underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、勤務シフトを交互に組まれますね
lines.en: The police are arranging work shifts in alternating rotations, aren't they?
lines.style: Warmer, slightly more personal. A trace of understanding—this is practical, human-centered. Conversational cadence. Closer, more direct eye-contact quality.
